svg.text: SERIES 1 • CARD 11 OF 11 • DOMAIN: 5-AND-10 GROUPING & DUAL-ROW ARITHMETIC • 20-BEAD REKENREK • 2 ROWS × 5 RED + 5 WHITE
LESSON GUIDE: DUAL-ROW BRIDGING & DOUBLES PLUS ONE
Grades K–3 Subitizing & Addition • Hands-On Classroom & Home STEM Studio Series

text.tspan: When you slide 7 beads on top and 6 on
bottom, how many red beads are on the

g.text: STEP 1: SLIDE 7 BEADS ON TOP ROW

text.tspan: Push all beads to the right side of the rack (resting zero).
Slide 7 beads to the left on the top rod in one push:
All 5 red beads + 2 white beads = 7 beads!
Notice: 5-anchor lets you see 7 instantly without counting.

g.text: STEP 2: SLIDE 6 BEADS ON BOTTOM ROW

text.tspan: Slide 6 beads to the left on the bottom rod in one push:
All 5 red beads + 1 white bead = 6 beads!
We want to find 7 + 6 without counting one-by-one.
3. GROUP RED BEADS: Look at the red beads on the left: 5 + 5 = 10 (Instant Ten)!
4. ADD WHITE BEADS: Look at the white beads: 2 + 1 = 3 units.
Calculator Verification: Press Number Rack Subitizing Icon ([▦]) and run [7] [ENTER] [6] [+] → 13.0000.

g.text: CORE PRINCIPLE: DOUBLES MAKE MENTAL MATH EFFORTLESS

text.tspan: Instead of counting 6 fingers past 7, the Rekenrek decomposes 7 + 6 into (5 + 2) + (5 + 1).
The two groups of 5 red beads instantly make 10, leaving 3 white beads. Addition becomes
instantaneous visual pattern recognition rather than tedious memorization!
Slide 8 beads on top (5 red + 3 white) and 7 on bottom (5 red + 2 white). Group the 10 red
beads first! What is the sum? (Scan QR for 3D animated solution!)

g.text: → Assemble with your physical blocks, then scan the QR code to verify with the 3D step-by-step vector model.
